cases.name: what_is_fermix
expectations: explains Fermix as an Elixir-native agent platform that runs as one OS daemon

cases.name: builtins_vs_skills
cases.prompt: What is the difference between a Fermix built-in tool and a skill?
expectations: distinguishes keyless built-ins seeded into the capability registry from SKILL.md instruction packages loaded via skill_view/skill_run

cases.name: change_model_or_provider
cases.prompt: How do I change which model or provider Fermix uses?
expectations: points to config.toml [fermix_core.agent] provider and [fermix_core.providers.<name>], and notes the change applies on restart

cases.name: what_can_tools_touch
cases.prompt: What can Fermix's tools read and write on my machine?
expectations: explains the sandbox gates file/exec built-ins with modes (strict/standard/open) and always-denied protected paths
